title: Singleton coefficient of a signed tail
statement: Let $n\geq 1$, let $t\in\mathbb R$, and choose a coordinate $i\in[n]$. The Fourier coefficient at $\{i\}$ of the signed two-sided tail of the normalized Rademacher sum equals twice the Fourier coefficient at $\{i\}$ of its upper-tail indicator.
